title: sig.workspace-state/1 parses and round-trips the jurisdiction, source, location and technology facets, but none of the three islands applies them: a place-scoped link (/map/?v=1&jurisdiction=TX) silently renders the unfiltered view with no issue note
evidence: workspace-state.ts documents jurisdiction (REPEATED place facet), technology, source and location (:17-25), lists jurisdiction/technology/source in REPEATED_FACETS (:60-66), parses them (:188-192) and serializes them (:217-221). grep -rn 'state\.(jurisdiction|source|location|technology)' web/src finds 0 consumers outside that serializer (worktree 3d1384c0 = chain tip b051732c for web/). MapIsland applies only collection (:193-200), focus (:458) and release (:485); NetworkIsland only focus and release (:79-85); SearchIsland q, kind and focus (:71-117). The islands show parse 'issues' (MapIsland.tsx:612-614), but a well-formed jurisdiction=TX is not an issue, so the page shows the national, unfiltered view while the URL claims a place filter, with no notice. No island has a control that sets these facets, so today only hand-made or future links carry them; but K4 JUR-04 (map links per index row), K6 (the dossier Explore bar) and K1/K2/K3 designs all plan to emit jurisdiction= links. Distinct from F-170 (view-switch links drop the live query) and K3 NEW-4 (technology facet has no data): this is the islands ignoring facets they accept. Fix owners: K1 MAP-03a, K2 GX-09a, K3 SRCH-05 apply the facet or show a 'this view does not filter by place yet' notice; K6 VIZ-03 links static equivalents until then (SIG-UI-DV04).

title: Symbol meanings collide across the K designs: K2 marks historical edges with a dash and undated with hollow, K14 reserves dashed for declared access and dotted for historical, and K1 uses hollow for single-source sites, so a dossier page carrying the map and a network figure would give 'hollow' and 'dashed' two meanings each
surface: docs/build/planning/2026-09-30-next-phase/design/K2-graph-and-entities.md §5.3 (keyboard and accessibility: 'dash = historical, hollow = undated'), §7 H-3 ('Dash + historical'); design/K14-visual-and-onboarding.md §4.7 (access kind: 'configured solid · declared dashed · observed double'; currency: 'Historical edges are dotted in graphs'); design/K1-map.md §3.5 ('Hollow means only one source says so'; provisional = dashed look)
evidence: Read of the three design notes at worktree 3d1384c0. K2 H-3 and §5.3 encode currency with a dash (historical) and hollow (undated). K14 §4.7 encodes access kind with line pattern (declared = dashed, SIG-UI-024 requires the three access kinds to be visually distinct) and currency with dotted strokes. K1 §3.5 makes hollow = single source on the map and uses a dashed look for provisional candidates. K6 places Figure 1 (map) and Figures 2-5 (networks) on the same dossier page and in the same printout, so a reader would meet hollow = one source and hollow = undated, and dashed = declared access and dashed = historical, on one sheet. SIG-UI-005 requires a redundant non-colour channel per epistemic state, which fails if the channel is ambiguous. K6 proposes one lexicon (line pattern = access kind only; currency = muted ink + words; hollow = one source only; D-K6-7). Not in FINDINGS or incoming (grep for hollow/dashed/dotted).

title: Ownership of the static SVG generators is circular across K rows: K1 says MAP-05 owns the static map renderer and K6 consumes it, while K2 cites 'K6's generator', K4 JUR-04 depends on 'K6 (locator)' and K5 DSRC-05 on a 'K6 chart component' that no row defines
surface: design/K1-map.md §12 ('The static map renderer: MAP-05 (K6 consumes)'), §8 row 'Static map renderer'; design/K2-graph-and-entities.md §4.2 row 10 ('K6's generator'), §10 GX-06 depends 'K6 SVG generator (shared)', §13 K6 row; design/K4-dossier-index.md §6 'Map entry' and §9 JUR-04 depends 'K6 (locator)'; design/K5-dossier-sources.md §4.2 'Over time' ('K6 shares the chart component'), §7, §9 DSRC-05 depends 'K6 chart component'; design/K14-visual-and-onboarding.md §9 UXK14-8 (static SVG builders for range, bars, timelines, small graphs; depends K2/K6)
evidence: Read of five design notes at worktree 3d1384c0. Four rows name another row as owner of overlapping generators (map renderer, locator, entity map snippet, chart component), and one of them (the 'K6 chart component') is defined by no row. Under P9 (exactly-one disposition) and at T3 ticket merge this would yield either duplicate implementations or a dependency cycle (MAP-05 waits on K6; K6 waits on MAP-05). K6 §14 proposes one owner per item: renderer core = K1 MAP-05 (or VIZ-01a if it lands first, recorded at T3); dossier map, locator, index sprite and entity map snippet = K6 VIZ-01a/02; ego and overview SVG = K2 GX-06b/GX-08; static charts and legends = K14 UXK14-8; chart brushing = K5 DSRC-05. Not in FINDINGS or incoming.
